oneTryTip: A mistake counts as a miss and wipes out two solved puzzles: the next puzzle comes right away.

launch.title: Puzzle Rush
launch.lead: As many puzzles as possible in a fixed time, harder and harder. A mistake doesn't stop you, but it wipes out two solved puzzles: go fast, but be accurate.
launch.rankedOnly: Only rushes played to the end, without themes, count for records.

result.unranked: Not counted for records (stopped before the end, or with themes)
